verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs state that it tracks requirements, features, and bugs "through columns and issues" and manages work through "kanban boards," so it directly provides the board-with-columns capability. Both statements are brief, marketing-level claims with no detail on how boards behave. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of board and column behavior (creating or customizing columns, moving cards between columns, board scope), and independent or hands-on corroboration of kanban use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plan and track work on kanban boards with columns

citations.quote: Efficiently manage requirements, features, and bugs through issue tasks, labels, and kanban boards.
Gitea tracks project requirements, features, and bugs through columns and issues.
